A THOUGHTFUL LITTLE MATCH

Find your next move.

Sell early for best per-card rewards or wait for set bonus, exchange unwanted goods/camels to change market mix, avoid giving rival an easy large set, and manage hand cap.

Take a seat
How to play
Market five goods/camel cards, personal hand cap seven plus camel herd. Turn take one good, take all camels, exchange two or more own goods/camels for same number market goods, or sell a same-type set. Rare goods require at least two to sell. Public per-good reward stacks diminish with successive sales; set size 3/4/5 grants stated bonus. Sold cards leave. Market refills from deck; three depleted reward stacks or exhausted deck ends. A 48-combined-turn limit also ends the match. An exchange cannot offer and receive the same goods type.
Higher coin total plus five-point larger camel herd bonus wins, equal draws.
